text:
- Split the input sentence by single spaces into a list of words; precompute primality for possible word lengths up to 100 (or up to max word length in the sentence) using a simple sieve or trial division.
- Filter the words by keeping those whose lengths are prime (e.g., primes: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, ...); note that single-letter words (length 1) are excluded since 1 is not prime.
- Join the filtered words with a single space and return the resulting string; handle cases with no prime-length words by returning an empty string.
